All of this focus on individual releases also misses the broader point with much bigger implications for all of us: rapid, continuing acceleration of model development is very obviously happening and is the thing to actually pay attention to.

I am sure there are many use cases where 6.2 will be the best model. It can also be good to have models that differ from each other in strengths and weaknesses. And in some short period of time there will be another version of Astra, and the existing models will be tweaked.

I’d note that OpenAI has always been great about not influencing early testers & has encouraged candid feedback. The mixed initial 6.2 reactions from testers didn’t blindside them.

Some model point releases are just weirder, I wouldn’t overindex on it as a sign of the future.

Google, OpenAI & Anthropic are at the stage where, unless you frequently switch between them or actively test them, you are probably very happy with the series of releases in the past two months. Even the model releases that are not as strong represent large capability gains
